text: “Is that why your presidents are elected?” “Yes,” answered Ceddie cheerfully. “When a man is very good and knows a great deal, he is elected president. They have torch-light processions and bands, and everybody makes speeches. I used to think I might perhaps be a president, but I never thought of being an earl. I didn't know about earls,” he said, rather hastily, lest Mr. Havisham might feel it impolite in him not to have wished to be one,--“if I'd known about them, I dare say I should have thought I should like to be one.” “It is rather different from being a president,” said Mr. Havisham.
